M3c.note: selection rules: original = argmin of (F^p + W^p)^(1/p) (exact ties at F go to the first chunk, 32); launch_default = exact ties go to the work-bound optimum argmin_C (b C + g / C); launch_default_near = ties within a relative 1e-6; work_argmin = argmin of W (no floor); regrets are per-call relative means unless stated; latency_weighted = sum of excess latency / sum of oracle latency.

boundary.formula: launch-bound while B*L < F / (a + 2 sqrt(b g)) (continuous optimum C* = sqrt(g/b)); at chunk 256: F / (a + 256 b + g / 256); a, b, g held at the fitted values
